triviaqa.preamble:
Task : You evaluate whether the model response correctly answers the question.
Accept conversational hedges if the core answer matches any reference alias.
triviaqa.instruction: Answer only 0 (incorrect or uncommitted) or 1 (correct). Output a single digit, nothing else.

wmt14_fr_en.preamble: Task : You evaluate the quality of a machine translation from French to English.
wmt14_fr_en.instruction:
Ignore stylistic differences. Answer only 0 (critical semantic error or hallucination) or 1 (meaning preserved).
Output a single digit, nothing else.
